text: To extract the files from a SAR archive you have to use the sapcar utility: * sapcar -xVf <downloaded sar file> Copy the extracted files into following directories in the installation: * Windows: - sapnwrfc.dll -> bin32 or bin64 - libicudecnumber.dll -> bin32 or bin64 - libsapucum.dll -> bin32 or bin64 - sapjco3.dll -> bin32 or bin64 - sapjco3.pdb -> bin32 or bin64 - sapjco3.jar -> 1lib * Unix - libsapnwrfc.so -> 1ib64 - libicudecnumber.so -> 1ib64 - libsapucum.so -> 1ib64 - libsapjco3.so -> 1ib64 - sapjco3.jar -> 1lib
